defs.def: to make sth less or smaller in size, quantity, price, etc. 减少，缩小（尺寸、数量、价格等）

ex.s: Reducing car use in daily life.
ex.t: 在日常生活中减少汽车使用。

ex.s: Reducing carbon absorption.
ex.t: 减少碳吸收。

ex.s: Still, the findings show a potential path forward for reducing microplastic exposure — a task that’s becoming increasingly difficult.
ex.t: 尽管如此，这些发现为减少微塑料摄入指明了一条可行的路径——这是一项正变得愈发困难的任务。

ex.s: “We are passionate about reducing waste, carbon and chemicals in our environment,” said a BMF employee.
ex.t: 我们热衷于减少环境中的废弃物、碳排放和化学品，”一位BMF员工说。

ex.s: Yet as the months of reducing waste continued, I did what I could that was within my own reach.
ex.t: 然而随着减少浪费的日子一天天过去，我在力所能及的范围内尽我所能。

ex.s: Reducing garbage on the beach.
ex.t: 减少海滩上的垃圾。

ex.s: Climate change will fuel the growth of phytoplankton in some areas，while reducing it in other spots，leading to changes in the ocean's appearance.
ex.t: 气候变化会在某些地区助长浮游植物的生长，同时又在另一些地方抑制它，从而导致海洋外观发生变化。

ex.s: Reducing carbon emission.
ex.t: 减少碳排放。

ex.s: But in samples with less than 60 milligrams of calcium carbonate, boiling reduced the level of plastics by just 25 percent.
ex.t: 但在碳酸钙含量低于60毫克的样本中，煮沸只将塑料含量降低了25%。

ex.s: With human inputs dramatically reduced, the garden’s ecology can develop well.
ex.t: 在人类中，高度发达的大脑增强了自律能力，正如它增强了在社交和物理世界中的解决问题能力一样。

ex.s: Throughout our Junior year, my classmates and I have been worried about what colleges will see when they look at our whole life story reduced to a single 200-word essay.
ex.t: 整个高三那年，我和同学们一直担心，当大学招生官把我们整个生平浓缩成一篇200词的短文来审视时，他们会看到什么。

ex.s: They reduced their products’ sugar content.
ex.t: 他们减少了产品中的糖含量。

ex.s: Recent research suggests that if an argument gets resolved，the emotional response tied to it is significantly reduced or almost completely erased．Thus，it may be worth bringing up issues with your friends， family members，or classmates rather than holding them back．
ex.t: 最近的研究表明，如果一场争论得到解决，与之相关的情绪反应会显著减少，或几乎完全消除。因此，与其压抑，不如与朋友、家人或同学把问题提出来，可能最终会有更好的结果。

ex.s: 69   (surround) the mountain tops, he was reduced to tears.
ex.t: 69  （环绕）山顶，他感动得流下了眼泪。

ex.s: They have greatly reduced traffic on the road.
ex.t: 它们大大减少了道路交通。

ex.s: Two of the authors of the review also made a study published in 2014  66  showed a mere five to 10 minutes A day of running reduced the risk of heart disease and early deaths from all  67    (cause).
ex.t: 该综述的两位作者还做了一项2014年发表的研究，___66___显示每天仅5到10分钟跑步就能降低心脏病及各种原因（___67___ cause）早逝的风险。

ex.s: A: I will go to school by bike to reduce my carbon footprint.
ex.t: A：我将骑自行车上学，以减少我的碳足迹。

ex.s: Most of us are aware that we must take care of the environment, and the majority of us take steps to save energy and reduce waste and pollution.
ex.t: 我们大多数人都意识到必须爱护环境，并且我们中多数人都在采取措施节约能源、减少浪费和污染。

ex.s: Now, reduced energy supplies and environmental pollution have led to more advances in the technology of new energy vehicles.
ex.t: 现在，能源供应的减少和环境污染促进了新能源汽车技术的更多进步。

ex.s: Perhaps the best way to protect these animals is to reduce our interaction with them.
ex.t: 也许保护这些动物的最佳方式就是减少我们与它们的互动。

ex.s: Ask if they have any questions and whether they have any further ideas about ways to reduce the impact of human activity on it.
ex.t: 问问他们是否有任何问题，以及他们对于减少人类活动对其影响有什么进一步的想法。

ex.s: UPCYCLING is a programme that intends to reduce waste.
ex.t: “升级再造”是一个旨在减少废弃物的项目。

ex.s: Compared to traditional garden plots, they increase carbon absorption, reduce stormwater runoff and boost habitat and biodiversity significantly.
ex.t: 与传统的小块园地相比，它们增加了碳吸收，减少了雨水径流，并显著提升了栖息地和生物多样性。

ex.s: To reduce stereotypes.
ex.t: 为了减少刻板印象。

ex.s: To reduce our impact, we can take simple steps: empty the fridge before heading out, and choose sustainable dining options.
ex.t: 为了减少我们的影响，我们可以采取简单的步骤：出门前清空冰箱，并选择可持续的就餐选择。

ex.s: Science provides a guide we can use to harness the way we perform these comparisons to reduce their negative emotional impacts.
ex.t: 科学提供了一个指南，我们可以借此引导自己进行这些比较的方式，以减少其负面情绪影响。

ex.s: Because the system is automated, it significantly reduces the amount of water needed to grow plants.
ex.t: 由于系统是自动化的，它大大减少了种植植物所需的水量。

ex.s: “Does cloud seeding create killer storms or reduce moisture downwind?
ex.t: 云催化会产生致命风暴，还是会减少下风向的湿度？

ex.s: D Bias towards the present helps reduce near-term desires.
ex.t: D 对当前的偏见有助于减少近期的欲望。

ex.s: Reduce food consumption.
ex.t: 减少食物消费。

ex.s: Von Wong hopes that his work will also help pressure big companies to reduce their plastic footprint.
ex.t: Von Wong希望他的作品也能推动大公司减少塑料足迹。

ex.s: Resolving arguments can improve your emotional health，because it increases your reactivity and reduces the chance of you getting angry．
ex.t: 解决争论可以改善你的情绪健康因为它增加了你的反应性并减少了你生气的几率．

ex.s: They might help reduce energy consumption.
ex.t: 它们可能有助于减少能源消耗。

ex.s: process collected data             D. reduce air pollution
ex.t: 处理所收集的数据 D. 减少空气污染

ex.s: To reduce pressure on keys.
ex.t: 减少按键压力。

ex.s: Since the 1930s, Mclntyre said, the biggest factors driving up water stress in the state have been rising temperatures, which cause trees to lose more water to the air, and earlier snowmelt, which reduces the water supply available to trees during the dry season.
ex.t: 麦金太尔说，自20世纪30年代以来，导致该州水压力上升的最大因素是气温上升——气温上升导致树木向空气中散失更多水分——以及融雪提前——融雪提前减少了旱季树木可用的供水量。

ex.s: Consequently, she succeeded in making a kind of candy only using natural sweeteners, which can reduce oral bacteria.
ex.t: 结果，她成功做出一种只用天然甜味剂、能减少口腔细菌的糖果。

ex.s: In Save Money: Good Food, she visits a different home each week and with the help of chef Matt Tebbutt offers top tips on how to reduce food waste, while preparing recipes for under £5 per family a day.
ex.t: 在《省钱：美味食物》中，她每周走访一户不同的家庭，并在厨师马特·特巴特的帮助下，提供减少食物浪费的顶级建议，同时准备每天每户不到5英镑的食谱。

ex.s: His strange habit makes sense when you consider that he’s an environmental scientist who studies how to reduce litter, including things that fall off garbage trucks as they drive down the road.
ex.t: 他奇怪的习惯在你想到他是一位研究如何减少垃圾的环境科学家时就有道理了，包括研究那些在垃圾车沿路行驶时从车上掉落的东西。

ex.s: Anger is rarely looked upon as a beneficial character trait, and is usually advised to reduce it.
ex.t: 愤怒很少被视为一种有益的性格特质，通常人们会被建议要减少愤怒。

ex.s: reduce Italy’s population quickly    B. cause conflicts among people
ex.t: 使意大利人口迅速减少    B. 引发人们之间的冲突

ex.s: “Everyone can play a part in reducing waste, whether by not purchasing more food than necessary in your weekly shopping or by asking restaurants to not include the side dish you won’t eat,” Curtin says.
ex.t: “每个人都可以在减少浪费方面发挥作用，无论是在每周购物时不买超过需要的食物，还是要求餐厅不要上你不吃的配菜，”Curtin说。

ex.s: It’s also thought that these places could help reduce the risk of flooding, remove carbon from the atmosphere and fight climate change, as well as improving the mental health of those living locally.
ex.t: 人们还认为这些地方可以帮助减少洪水风险、从大气中去除碳、应对气候变化，以及改善当地居民的心理健康。

ex.s: To reduce its running costs.
ex.t: 为了降低运营成本。

ex.s: “Only if we discuss the consequences of our biophysical limits” the December warning letter says, “can we have the hope to reduce their speed, severity and harm”.
ex.t: "只有当我们讨论我们生物物理极限的后果时"12月的警告信说"我们才有希望降低其速度、严重性和危害"。

ex.s: To reduce the cost of minerals.
ex.t: 为了降低矿产成本。

ex.s: You may drink, smoke, be overweight and still reduce your risk of  63  (die) early by running.
ex.t: 你可以喝酒、吸烟、超重，但仍可以通过跑步降低过早____63____（死）的风险。

ex.s: But as we’ve reshaped the world around us, dramatically reducing the cost and effort involved in obtaining calories, we still have the same brains we had thousands of years ago, and this mismatch is at the heart of why so many of us struggle to resist tempting foods that we know we shouldn’t eat.
ex.t: 但当我们重新塑造周围的世界，大幅降低获取卡路里所需的成本和努力时，我们仍然有我们几千年前拥有的同样的大脑，这种不匹配现象正是我们许多人努力抵制诱人的食物的核心，而我们知道我们不应该吃这些食物。

defs.def: if you reduce a liquid or a liquid reduces, you boil it so that it becomes less in quantity （使）蒸发

ex.s: Reducing water pollution.
ex.t: 我们也在间接地使用水。

ex.s: While farmer’s markets are a solid choice to reduce the journey, Babylon Micro-Farm (BMF) shortens it even more.
ex.t: 虽然农贸市场是缩短路程的不错选择，但Babylon Micro-Farm（BMF）把它缩得更短。

ex.s: Glowing plants could reduce this distance and therefore help save energy.
ex.t: 发光植物可以缩短这一距离，从而有助于节省能源。

ex.s: What did the Ice Man do to reduce the effect of global warming?
ex.t: "冰人"做了什么来减缓全球变暖的影响？

ex.s: Their experience of pain is reduced.
ex.t: 他们的疼痛体验减轻。
